request.description: Initialise une seule fois run_id et run_t0, puis récupère le JWT administrateur.

exec: const now = new Date();
const t0 = new Date(now.getTime() - 5 * 60 * 1000);
const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');

const dateOnly = (offset) => { const d = new Date(Date.UTC(t0.getUTCFullYear(), t0.getUTCMonth(), t0.getUTCDate() - offset)); return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getUTCDate())}`; };
const dateAt = (offset, hour = 0) => `${dateOnly(offset)}T${pad(hour)}:00:00.000Z`;
const iso = (d) => d.toISOString();
pm.collectionVariables.set('run_t0', iso(t0));

pm.collectionVariables.set('run_id', `PM-${t0.getUTCFullYear()}${pad(t0.getUTCMonth()+1)}${pad(t0.getUTCDate())}-${pad(t0.getUTCHours())}${pad(t0.getUTCMinutes())}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase()}`);
for (const n of [1, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 28, 30, 32, 33, 34, 35, 40]) pm.collectionVariables.set(`date_jminus_${n}`, dateOnly(n));
pm.collectionVariables.set('date_today', dateOnly(0));
pm.collectionVariables.set('date_jplus_30', dateOnly(-30));
pm.collectionVariables.set('date_future', dateAt(-1, 12));
pm.collectionVariables.set('date_event_jminus_22', dateAt(22));
pm.collectionVariables.set('date_event_jminus_21', dateAt(21));
pm.collectionVariables.set('date_event_jminus_5', dateAt(5));
pm.collectionVariables.set('date_event_today', iso(new Date(t0.getTime() - 60 * 1000)));
pm.collectionVariables.unset('event_sans_hapa');
pm.collectionVariables.unset('cons_sans_hapa');
pm.collectionVariables.set('date_distribution_j23_1', dateAt(23, 4));
pm.collectionVariables.set('date_distribution_j23_2', dateAt(23, 8));
pm.collectionVariables.set('date_distribution_j23_3', dateAt(23, 12));

for (const [k, delta] of [['distribution_today_1', -4], ['distribution_today_2', -3], ['distribution_today_3', -2], ['distribution_today_4', -1]]) pm.collectionVariables.set(k, iso(new Date(t0.getTime() + delta * 60 * 1000)));
